forbidden.title: You do not have access to knowledge documents
forbidden.description: Ask an administrator for read access to assets if you need to see owner manuals and other documents.

field.modelHint: A code: lower-case letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores.
field.variantHint: Leave empty for all variants of the model.
field.yearsHint: Leave both empty for every year. For a single year, enter it in both.
field.themeHint: Optional, for example a drivetrain or a market. Your tenant decides the themes.

errors.codeInvalid: Use lower-case letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores only (up to 100 characters).
errors.yearInvalid: Enter a four-digit year between 1900 and 2100.
errors.yearsBoth: Enter both years, or leave both empty.
errors.yearsOrder: The first year cannot be later than the last.
errors.nameLong: The name can have up to 200 characters.
errors.priorityInvalid: Enter a whole number, for example 0 or 10.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Owner manuals and other documents that an app can find from a VIN, each an existing asset mapped to a model, variant, years and language.
documents.loadFailed: The documents could not be loaded
documents.loadFailedHint: Check your connection and try again.

empty.title: No knowledge documents yet
empty.manage: Map an existing manual, document or HTML5 asset to a model, variant, years and language so apps can find it from a VIN.
empty.read: No document has been mapped yet. An administrator or librarian can map manuals and other documents.

map.alreadyMapped: This asset is already mapped as a knowledge document. Edit its mapping instead.
map.forbidden: You need permission to edit this asset to map it.
map.saveFailed: The mapping could not be saved. {{reason}}

picker.label: Asset
picker.hint: Manuals, documents and HTML5 bundles only.
picker.failed: The assets could not be searched. Try again.
picker.none: No manual, document or HTML5 asset found.

unmap.title: Remove this mapping?
unmap.body: {{title}} will no longer be found as a knowledge document.
unmap.note: The file is not deleted: the asset, its versions and its rights stay exactly as they are.
unmap.failed: The mapping could not be removed. {{reason}}

rules.title: VIN rules
rules.description: Patterns that turn a VIN into a model, variant, model year and theme. Among the rules that match, the highest priority wins, then the most specific pattern.

forbidden.title: You do not have access to VIN rules
forbidden.description: Only people who can edit assets or manage knowledge can see the rules.

rules.loadFailed: The VIN rules could not be loaded
rules.loadFailedHint: Check your connection and try again.

empty.title: No VIN rules yet
empty.manage: Add a rule, or import many from a CSV file, so a VIN can be turned into a model and year.
empty.read: No rule has been defined yet. An administrator or librarian can add them.

rules.searchPlaceholder: Name, pattern, model, variant or theme
rules.name: Name
rules.nameHint: Unique in your tenant. Importing a rule with the same name updates it.

yearMode.vin: Read it from the tenth character of the VIN

rules.saveFailed: The rule could not be saved. {{reason}}
rules.limitReached: A tenant can hold up to {{max}} VIN rules, and that limit is reached. Delete rules you no longer need.
rules.deleteNote: VINs it matched will resolve through other rules, or not at all. Documents are not affected.
rules.deleteFailed: The rule could not be deleted. {{reason}}

error.tooLong: A pattern can fix at most {{max}} characters, as a VIN has {{max}}.
error.badChar: "{{char}}" is not allowed. Use letters, digits, ?, [ ] and a final *.
error.emptySet: A set such as [ABC] cannot be empty.
error.badSetChar: "{{char}}" is not allowed inside [ ]. Use letters and digits, or a range such as A-C.
error.badRange: The range "{{char}}" is not valid. Write it from lower to higher, such as A-C.
error.starNotLast: A * can only be the last character.

pattern.matchesOpen_one: Matches VINs whose first character fits this pattern, whatever follows.
pattern.matchesOpen_other: Matches VINs whose first {{count}} characters fit this pattern, whatever follows.
pattern.matchesExact_one: Matches a VIN of exactly 1 character.
pattern.matchesExact_other: Matches a VIN of exactly {{count}} characters.
pattern.neverMatches_one: This pattern fixes 1 character and has no final *, so it cannot match a 17-character VIN. Add * at the end.
pattern.neverMatches_other: This pattern fixes {{count}} characters and has no final *, so it cannot match a 17-character VIN. Add * at the end.

help.intro: A pattern is compared with the VIN from its first character. Case does not matter.
help.literal: A letter or digit matches itself, so this matches VINs that begin with those characters:
help.any: A question mark matches any one character:
help.set: Square brackets match one character from a list:
help.range: Or one character from a range:
help.rest: A final star matches whatever follows:
help.length: Without a final star the pattern must be exactly as long as the VIN (17 characters).
help.full: is a full-length pattern: it matches one VIN only.
help.specific: When several rules match, the highest priority wins; then the rule with the most fixed characters; then the oldest.

vin.label: VIN
vin.hint: 17 letters and digits, without I, O or Q. Spaces are removed and letters are made upper-case.

problem.chars: A VIN has letters and digits only.
problem.forbidden: A VIN never contains the letters I, O or Q.
problem.length: A VIN has {{max}} characters; this has {{count}}.

test.title: Test a VIN
test.hint: See which rule would be chosen for a VIN, and why each rule matched or not. Nothing is saved.
test.failed: The VIN could not be tested. {{reason}}
test.noCandidates: There are no enabled rules to compare.

import.title: Import VIN rules
import.intro: Rules are matched to existing ones by name: a name that exists is updated, a new name is added. Check the file first; nothing is saved until you choose Import.
import.columns: Columns, in this order, with a header line

col.name: A unique name for the rule.
col.pattern: The VIN pattern, for example ACMLS1*.
col.variant: The variant code. Leave empty for all variants.
col.year: A four-digit model year, or "vin" or empty to read it from the VIN.

import.fileFailed: The file could not be read.
import.partial: Import the valid lines even if some lines have errors
import.partialHint: Without this, nothing is imported while any line has an error.
import.blocked: Fix the lines above and check again, or choose to import the valid lines only.
import.nothing: There is nothing to import in this file.

resolver.title: VIN resolver
resolver.description: Enter a VIN to see what an app would be shown for it: the rule that matched, the vehicle and the document with its chapters.

malformed.title: {{vin}} is not a valid VIN
malformed.hint: A VIN has 17 letters and digits, without I, O or Q.

unknownVin.title: No rule matches {{vin}}
unknownVin.hint: The VIN is well formed, but no enabled VIN rule covers it. Add or adjust a rule, then try again.

noDocument.title: No document found for {{vin}}
noDocument.hint: A rule matches this VIN, but no document of this type is mapped for the vehicle, or you are not allowed to see it.

forbidden.title: You are not allowed to look up VINs
forbidden.hint: Ask an administrator for read access to assets.

failed.title: The VIN could not be looked up
failed.hint: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

chapters.editHint: Chapters you enter here are kept when the file is indexed again, unless you choose to replace them. Level 1 is a main chapter; a higher level sits inside the one before it.
chapters.saveFailed: The chapters could not be saved. {{reason}}

errors.titleLong: A title can have up to {{max}} characters.
errors.pageOrder: The last page cannot be before the first.
errors.tooMany: A document can have up to {{limit}} chapters.

card.title: Knowledge
card.error: The knowledge mapping could not be loaded.
card.notMappedBody: Map this file to a model, variant, years and language so apps can find it from a VIN.
card.noChapters: No chapters were found in this file. You can enter them by hand.
card.reindexStarted: Re-indexing the chapters. They update in a moment.
card.reindexFailed: The chapters could not be re-indexed. {{reason}}
card.replaceBody: These chapters were entered by hand. Re-indexing reads the file again and replaces them with what it finds.
